entry.name: dateFormat
entry.label: Qt date format for the second line: "M/d" gives 10/31, "d/M" gives 31/10

entry.name: showAmPm
entry.label: Append A or P to the 12-hour time (1:38 P)

entry.name: localeName
entry.label: Locale for the tooltip's long date; empty follows the system

entry.name: fontScale
entry.label: Text size relative to the bar width in a vertical bar (32px bar → 11px text; shrinks if the date would not fit)
